Espressif Systems ESP32-C6-DevKitC-1 Development Board
Espressif Systems ESP32-C6-DevKitC-1 Development Board is based on the ESP32-C6-WROOM-1
module offering 8MB SPI flash. This development board integrates complete Wi-Fi®, BLUETOOTH® LE,
Zigbee®, and thread functions. The USB Type-C™ to UART Port is used for supplying power to the board,
as well as for communication with the ESP32-C6 chip. This ESP32-C6-DevKitC-1 development board

features a USB-to-UART bridge, pin header, boot, and reset button. The development board operates at
3.3V power on LED, and the power regulator converts the 5V supply to 3.3V output.
FEATURES
• Based on ESP32-C6-WROOM-1(U)
• Integrates complete Wi-Fi, BLUETOOTH LE, Zigbee, and Thread functions
• Pin header
• Boot button
• Reset button
• 3.3V power on LED
• 5V to 3.3V LDO
• USB-to-UART bridge provides transfer rates up to 3Mbps
